_guide: Desktop reloads this file when opening the title, starting a run/duel or restocking. Existing shop prices are fixed until the next shop. Rebuild Android to bundle edits. IDs are stable; numerical effects use amount. Compound options are documented in parameters.

_fields.name: Display name
_fields.description: Player-facing description; update it if changing a numerical effect
_fields.amount: Effect magnitude, or purchase interval for single_stamp. Only numeric effects use this value.
_fields.effect: Existing engine effect identifier; changing this changes the relic behavior. New identifiers require passives.py/campaign_expansion.py implementation.
_fields.filter: Optional monster Type or Attribute supported by passives.py
_fields.art: Existing card name used as artwork
_fields.parameters: Optional effect-specific settings. diversity/normal_grave: cap; dial: defense.

ankh.name: Diamond Ankh
ankh.description: When acquired, gain 2000 LP. Increase your between-duel healing limit by 2000 LP.

feather.name: Phoenix Feather
feather.description: After each victory, gain 400 LP, up to your current healing limit.

urn.name: Merchant Urn
urn.description: Earn 10 additional coins after each victory.

eye.name: Millennium Eye
eye.description: Your opening hand contains 1 additional card.

scarab.name: Jade Pendant
scarab.description: After each victory, gain 1,000 LP before entering the shop, up to your current healing limit.

seal.name: Broken Seal
seal.description: Your opponent starts each Duel with 1000 fewer LP after challenge-level rules (minimum 1 LP).

dragon.name: Dragon Crest
dragon.description: Dragon monsters you control gain 300 ATK.

mage.description: Spellcaster monsters you control gain 300 ATK.

blade.description: Warrior monsters you control gain 300 ATK.

wing.description: Winged Beast monsters you control gain 300 ATK.

gear.name: Ancient Gear
gear.description: Machine monsters you control gain 300 ATK.

shell.name: Tidal Shell
shell.description: Aqua monsters you control gain 300 ATK.

fossil.name: Amber Fossil
fossil.description: Dinosaur monsters you control gain 300 ATK.

hive.name: Amber Hive
hive.description: Insect monsters you control gain 300 ATK.

bone.name: Zombie Crystal
bone.description: Zombie monsters you control gain 300 ATK.

halo.name: Silver Halo
halo.description: Fairy monsters you control gain 300 ATK.

fang.name: Beast Fang
fang.description: Beast monsters you control gain 300 ATK.

horn.name: Fiend Horn
horn.description: Fiend monsters you control gain 300 ATK.

ember.name: Ember Orb
ember.description: FIRE monsters you control gain 250 ATK/DEF.

tide.name: Tide Orb
tide.description: WATER monsters you control gain 200 ATK/DEF.

gale.name: Gale Orb
gale.description: WIND monsters you control gain 200 ATK/DEF.

earth.name: Earth Orb
earth.description: EARTH monsters you control gain 200 ATK/DEF.

light.name: Light Orb
light.description: LIGHT monsters you control gain 200 ATK/DEF.

dark.name: Dark Orb
dark.description: DARK monsters you control gain 200 ATK/DEF.

normal.name: Normal Power
normal.description: Normal Monsters you control gain 400 ATK.

tribute.name: Tribute Power
tribute.description: Level 5 or higher monsters you control gain 400 ATK.

small.name: Tiny Courage
small.description: Level 3 or lower monsters you control gain 400 ATK.

spring.name: Healing Spring
spring.description: Once per turn, at the start of your Standby Phase, gain 200 LP.

flame.name: Eternal Flame
flame.description: Once per turn, at the start of your End Phase, inflict 200 damage to your opponent.

prism.name: Life Shield
prism.description: Each time you would take effect damage, reduce that damage by 400 (min. 0).

pierce.name: Lancer Spear
pierce.description: If a monster you control attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

chalice.name: Silver Chalice
chalice.description: After each victory, gain 600 LP, up to your current healing limit.

satchel.name: Travel Satchel
satchel.description: After each victory, add 1 additional random card from your opponent's duel decklist to your card pool. Dueling Engine gains 1 additional deck choice instead. Does not apply to Copycat.

interest.name: Golden Scale
interest.description: After each victory, earn additional coins equal to 10% of your held coins, rounded down (max. 30).

bandage.name: Red Medicine
bandage.description: After each victory, gain 500 LP before entering the shop, up to your current healing limit.

last_word.name: Last Word
last_word.description: While you have no cards in your hand, monsters you control gain 700 ATK.

solo.name: Lone Champion
solo.description: While you control exactly 1 monster, it gains 200 ATK.

menagerie.name: Prismatic Menagerie
menagerie.description: Monsters you control gain 100 ATK for each different Type among face-up monsters you control (max. 500).

epitaph.name: Commoner's Epitaph
epitaph.description: Monsters you control gain 75 ATK for each Normal Monster in your GY (max. 600).

eclipse.name: Eclipse Locket
eclipse.description: While you have both a LIGHT and a DARK monster in your GY, monsters you control gain 350 ATK/DEF.

pendulum.name: Sun and Moon Dial
pendulum.description: During your turn, monsters you control gain 100 ATK. During your opponent's turn, monsters you control gain 100 DEF.

desperate.name: Underdog's Banner
desperate.description: While your LP are lower than your opponent's and you control fewer monsters than they do, monsters you control gain 900 ATK.

inkwell.name: Bottomless Draw
inkwell.description: Once per turn, at the start of your End Phase, if you have no cards in your hand, draw 1 card.

receipt.name: Golden Receipt
receipt.description: After buying a booster pack, receive a refund of 12 coins (up to the price paid minus 1).

razor.name: Razor Ledger
razor.description: If you win a Duel with exactly 20 cards in your Main Deck, earn 30 additional coins.

phoenix_debt.name: Phoenix IOU
phoenix_debt.description: If you win a Duel with less than 2000 LP, earn 40 additional coins. Check your LP before post-duel healing.

stamp.name: Collector's Stamp
stamp.description: Every 1 single-card purchase includes 1 additional random unlocked card at no cost.

faulty_printer.name: Faulty Printer
faulty_printer.description: Each monster purchased as a single or pulled from a purchased booster has a 15% chance to become a misprint. A misprint changes that copy's original ATK and DEF independently by a random amount from -1000 to +1000 (min. 0).

golden_sleeve.name: Golden Card Sleeve
golden_sleeve.description: Designate 1 card in the deck editor. If you win a Duel, earn 10 additional coins for each time you Summoned, Set, or activated a card with that name during that Duel (max. 5 times).

magic_mirror.name: Magic Mirror
magic_mirror.description: At the start of each Duel, this artifact copies the effects of 1 random other artifact you own, except "Blank Relic", for that Duel.

underdog_clause.name: The Underdog Clause
underdog_clause.description: After each victory, earn 3 additional coins for each Level 2 or lower Normal Monster in your Main Deck.

traps_no_more.name: Traps No More
traps_no_more.description: Negate all Trap effects on the field and all activated Trap effects.

spells_no_more.name: Spells No More
spells_no_more.description: Negate all Spell effects on the field and all activated Spell effects.

legendary_shackles.name: Legendary Shackles
legendary_shackles.description: "Exodia the Forbidden One" and "Forbidden One" monsters appear more often in shops. Every third shop visit or reroll while this artifact is active guarantees 1 random Exodia piece in general stock.

toon_world.name: Toon World
toon_world.description: Toon cards appear more often in shops.

ritual_dagger.name: Ritual Dagger
ritual_dagger.description: Ritual Monsters and Ritual Spells appear more often in shops.

fusion_chamber.name: Fusion Chamber
fusion_chamber.description: Fusion Monsters, "Polymerization", and "Fusion Sage" appear more often in shops.

phoenix_rebirth.name: Phoenix Feather
phoenix_rebirth.description: Once per Duel, if your LP become 0, your LP become 1,000 instead and you do not lose the Duel for having 0 LP. After this effect is applied, this artifact is consumed.

champion_trophy.name: Champion Trophy
champion_trophy.description: Earn 40 additional coins after each boss victory.

glass_shard.name: Glass Shard
glass_shard.description: Your starting LP become 2,000 in each Duel, before boss LP penalties. Double your victory coin rewards, up to the reward limit.

deck_spyglass.name: Deck Spyglass
deck_spyglass.description: Reveals opponent portraits and lets you view their decks on the opponent-selection screen.

rulebook.name: Broke Man's Rulebook
rulebook.description: Both players start each Duel with 1 card in their hand, regardless of other opening-hand bonuses.

blank_relic.name: Blank Relic
blank_relic.description: After your next Duel, this artifact becomes an Attribute Orb matching the most common Attribute among monsters in your Main and Extra Decks. If there are no monsters, it becomes Earth Orb.

echo_glass.name: Echo Glass
echo_glass.description: Once per Duel, the first time your opponent Normal, Flip, or Special Summons a face-up Level 4 or lower monster, add a copy of 1 such monster to your hand.

attribute_light.name: Light Surgery
attribute_light.description: All face-up monsters you control become LIGHT.

attribute_dark.name: Dark Surgery
attribute_dark.description: All face-up monsters you control become DARK.

attribute_fire.name: Fire Surgery
attribute_fire.description: All face-up monsters you control become FIRE.

attribute_water.name: Water Surgery
attribute_water.description: All face-up monsters you control become WATER.

attribute_wind.name: Wind Surgery
attribute_wind.description: All face-up monsters you control become WIND.

attribute_earth.name: Earth Surgery
attribute_earth.description: All face-up monsters you control become EARTH.

arcane_resonance.name: Arcane Resonance
arcane_resonance.description: Monsters you control gain 100 ATK for each face-up Spell/Trap on the field.

waning_star.name: Waning Star
waning_star.description: Once per turn, at the start of your Standby Phase, reduce the Level of 1 random Level 2 or higher monster in your hand by 1 until the end of this turn.

third_gate.name: The Third Gate
third_gate.description: Count cards from either player that would be sent to the GY. Banish every third card instead. The count resets at the start of each Duel.

exile_standard.name: Exile Standard
exile_standard.description: Monsters you control gain 50 ATK for each face-up banished monster.

field_amplifier.name: Field Amplifier
field_amplifier.description: Double ATK/DEF increases applied by the effects of face-up Field Spells you control. ATK/DEF decreases are unchanged.

returning_tide.name: Returning Tide
returning_tide.description: Once per turn, at the start of your Standby Phase, return 1 Spell/Trap on the field to the hand.

ominous_clock.name: Ominous Clock
ominous_clock.description: Once per turn, at the start of your opponent's Standby Phase, inflict 200 damage to them.

final_hour.name: Final Hour
final_hour.description: When acquired, add 1 "Final Countdown" to your card pool. At the start of each Duel, add 1 "Final Countdown" to your hand.

archfiend_contract.name: Archfiend Contract
archfiend_contract.description: Adds one extra random Archfiend card to every shop and reroll.

loops._help: Bonuses per completed optional champion challenge. Applied to all enemy monsters and starting LP in subsequent loops.
